detect_signal: ^  Orphaned helpers \(installed, no longer in the checkout\): \S
limits: Covers the host-helpers ORPHAN axis only - an entry WE INSTALLED whose checkout source is gone. It does NOT cover current/stale/missing, which the parity loop already reports and which other tests pin, and it does NOT cover the Codex or Claude skill arms. TWO NARROWINGS, both deliberate and both the result of a refuted first design. (1) An orphan is identified by the INSTALL SHAPE - a symlink pointing at <some checkout>/scripts/<its own basename>, which is what cpp-host-write.sh link-into creates - and NOT by file type. The remedy this axis was approved under used [ -f ] || [ -L ] on the installed side, which reports every host-owned file in ~/.claude/scripts as an orphan; test_host_only_scripts_are_not_judged pins the opposite on purpose, because an axis that cries wolf on every host that keeps a tool there gets muted within a week. good-host-owned-file-not-judged and good-host-owned-dangling-symlink are the committed cases for that, so the narrowing is measured rather than asserted. (2) Keying on 'target is under $CHECKOUT' was measured WRONG and is not used: installed links point at whichever checkout installed them, which need not be the one a given run compares against - run from a worktree, that version reported the live specimen as 0 orphaned while it was sitting right there. DECLARED GAP: a COPY-installed helper whose source was deleted is a plain file, indistinguishable from a host-owned one without the HELPERS allowlist, which is not plumbed into this script - so this axis does not report it. detect_signal requires a NAMED member (the trailing \S), never a count, because over a real install directory the two candidate predicates both yield 91 entries and are DISJOINT on two members: a count reconcile passes with the wrong set, which is how #829's 20-vs-21 reconcile carried this blind spot in originally. An orphan is REPORTED and does not make the verdict drift, mirroring the Codex arm, so every case here exits 0 and the signal is the whole discriminator. TWO CASES ADDED FROM COUNTER-MODEL REVIEW (codex, both MEDIUM, both reproduced before fixing): good-another-projects-link is a link with the INSTALL SHAPE into a root that is not a CPP checkout - shape is not ownership, and before the fix a neighbour project moving its own file made this report OUR orphan; the pre-existing host-owned case missed it because its target had no scripts/ component, so it never exercised the shape test at all. bad-orphan-only-population has NO current helper, which scored zero on every term of the early nothing-found exit, so the axis was invisible in exactly the population where it is the only thing there is to say - every other fixture here happens to include a current helper, which is why none of them reached it. DECLARED LIMIT added with the ownership fix: a link into a checkout removed ENTIRELY cannot be attributed and is not reported - an unreported orphan is a gap, an unattributed accusation about someone else's file is a defect. THE DANGLING FIXTURES CARRY NO FILE EXTENSION, deliberately. The live specimen is a .py, but ruff cannot stat a dangling symlink and reported E902 'Failed to create cache key' on one named .py, failing `make lint`. The alternative was adding the fixtures to the ruff exclusion list in pyproject.toml - a list #1180 deliberately made NAMED-FILES-ONLY and pinned with test_the_ruff_fixture_exclusions_have_not_grown precisely so it does not grow. Widening it for a fixture that does not need an extension would spend that guard for nothing, and the axis keys on the install SHAPE, never on the name: extension is incidental to what is being measured.

anchors.why: HISTORICAL, not constructed: the script exactly as it stood at 5a4d7fc, vendored byte-for-byte. No reconstruction was needed because the blindness is the shipped behaviour - the arm reports current/stale/missing over a population derived entirely from the checkout, so on the known-bad case it prints '1 current, 0 stale, 0 missing' and 'installed helpers and Codex skills match the checkout', exit 0, with the dangling install sitting right there. That is the measurement on nit store #864, reproduced from the control rather than asserted, and it is what makes the post-fix green a change in the gate rather than a change in the cases.
